description: Source code for MacroMenuRenderer class implementing MenuStringRenderer, responsible for rendering menu components using FreeMarker templates within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: MacroMenuRenderer
classes.description: Implements menu rendering using FreeMarker templates, handling macro execution, link and image rendering, and menu structure output.

methods.name: createImageParameters
methods.description: Constructs parameters for image rendering, resolving URLs based on context and request.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Executes a macro template with optional parameters, including macro count management.

methods.name: executeMacro
methods.description: Overloaded method to execute a macro with parameters, constructing macro invocation string.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker environment for macro rendering associated with a writer.

methods.name: isDisableIfEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a menu item should be disabled based on empty context values.

methods.name: isHideIfSelected
methods.description: Determines if a menu item should be hidden when it is the selected item.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperClose
methods.description: No operation; placeholder for closing wrapper.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperOpen
methods.description: No operation; placeholder for opening wrapper.

methods.name: renderFormatSimpleWrapperRows
methods.description: Renders each menu item in the menu.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Renders an image using macro execution with generated parameters.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Renders a link, handling URL, confirmation, modal, and image inclusion.

methods.name: renderMenuClose
methods.description: Renders closing tags and optional boundary comments for a menu.

methods.name: renderMenuItem
methods.description: Renders a menu item, including nested menus, with style and link processing.

methods.name: renderMenuOpen
methods.description: Renders opening tags and boundary comments for a menu.
